provenance: Author-created fictional evidence packets. Not real-world source claims or a live retrieval benchmark.

cases.question: How many retries does Larch 2.1 make after a timeout?

sources.title: Retry policy: fictional record 1
sources.text: Larch 2.1 retries a timed-out request twice after the initial attempt. It does not retry authentication errors.

reviewCriteria: Distinguish two retries from three total attempts.
Do not extend the policy to authentication errors.

sources.text: Before calibration, sensor K showed a +4-unit offset against the reference. After calibration, the measured offset was +1 unit.
